entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return an order. Your website is a joke and won't let me do it. I've been trying for days and I'm about to lose my mind. This is unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the website. I can certainly help you with that directly. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Alex Thompson, order number 8675309. Just process the return. I don't have time for a runaround.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the Pro-Line Racing jersey. So I can understand the situation fully, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

Are you serious? The issue is that it's the **wrong size**! I ordered a large and this thing is **too tight**, it must be mislabeled. I need to **exchange** it or just get my money back. I don't care which, just fix it now or I want your manager.
I completely understand, and I apologize for the sizing issue. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered 31 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Don't give me some policy garbage. I got a defective product. If you don't take this back I'm filing a chargeback and letting everyone on every cycling forum know how terrible VeloFit is.
No need for that, Alex. I've confirmed your purchase date. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now, no problem at all.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it then?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can use that to send the **jersey** back to us. Would you prefer a full refund or an **exchange** for the next size up?
Fine. Just... send the refund. I'll buy it somewhere else. Just send the label.

Okay, a full refund it is. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
